look_here_first: Annual or biennial sneezeweed with winged stems and an unmistakably elongated ovoid-to-conical central disk surrounded by yellow rays.

key_traits.label: Family pattern
key_traits.text: Asteraceae/Helenium: composite heads with a raised receptacle, yellow or partly darkened rays, and often winged stems from decurrent leaf bases. Habit, stem wings, disk shape/color, and ray form are high-value characters.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: leaves variable from broad to grasslike

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: disk often yellow below and yellow-brown toward tips

lookalikes.differences: The name is literal: longdisk. The elongated cone-like disk is the fastest split from the more rounded heads of H. elegans and H. autumnale.
